jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
jobs.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- ADCI - BLR 14 SEZ

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a
**Software Engineer (Backend)**
to join the team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis!
  
  
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
  
  
WWE Champions is our ultimate and unique RPG puzzle match game featuring WWE superstars and legends across mobile and PC platforms. WWE Champions is the most downloaded WWE game to date, with a highly engaged and passionate community
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a Software Engineer, you will build and maintain backend systems that power core gameplay and live-service operations. Working within an established Python and Django codebase, you will deliver features, investigate issues, and improve the reliability and performance of a live game. You will collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners, taking ownership of scoped work from implementation through testing and release.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and maintain backend features supporting gameplay, live events, progression, rewards, social features, and platform capabilities.
* Build and update APIs, game logic, background jobs, caching, persistence, and internal operational tools.
* Extend existing systems with readable, maintainable code that follows established patterns.
* Write automated tests and work with QA to validate functionality, edge cases, and regression risks.
* Investigate bugs and production issues using code, logs, and available monitoring tools, collaborating with teammates on fixes.
* Contribute improvements to performance, reliability, observability, and code quality.
* Work with product, design, QA, analytics, and other engineers to clarify requirements and deliver features.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, incorporating feedback and sharing what you learn.
* Identify technical debt and operational risks, communicate concerns, and contribute to prioritized improvements.
* Support releases and live operations by validating changes, monitoring outcomes, and escalating issues when needed.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2+ years of professional software development experience, preferably working on backend services or applications.
* Proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming.

jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

This team doesn't treat AI tools as an occasional productivity add-on. Anthropic Claude is a full-time engineering partner on this team — used daily to generate, review, refactor, test, and document code across our .NET backend, React frontend, and Azure cloud infrastructure. Engineers here are expected to think in terms of prompt design, context management, and AI-output validation as a core part of their craft, not a side skill.

We are looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer / BSA who will support CHEC development while also acting as a Business Systems Analyst, bridging business needs, user workflows, and technical implementation. This is a growth role designed to develop you into a full-stack engineer. You will build features under senior guidance, gather and translate requirements, and support validation activities. AI fluency is a core competency on this team - you will use AI coding assistants as daily development and learning tools, building foundational prompt engineering skills alongside your engineering capabilities.

The Custom Hardware and Electronics Configurator (CHEC) team builds and maintains DTNA's proprietary web-based tool that enables Truck Equipment Manufacturers (TEMs), dealers, and internal teams to configure and validate vehicle electrical features. CHEC operates in a safety-relevant, high-complexity domain where usability, correctness, and delivery discipline are critical.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain frontend and backend features under senior guidance, using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as daily development tools
* Build foundational prompt engineering skills — learn to structure context, constraints, and intent so Claude produces accurate, production-aligned code on the first or second pass
* Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs against CHEC's safety-relevant correctness standards; learn to identify when AI output is subtly wrong, incomplete, or needs re-prompting rather than accepting it uncritically
* Assist with bug fixes, enhancements, and technical documentation, leveraging AI tools to accelerate debugging and documentation workflows
* Gather and clarify requirements from stakeholders, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and identify gaps
* Translate user needs into user stories and acceptance criteria, leveraging AI tools for drafting and refinement
* Support validation and UAT activities
* Collaborate with UX, Product Owners, and engineering teams
* Participate in testing, demos, and release activities
* Build foundational prompt engineering skills for code generation, testing, and requirements analysis
* Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and learn to refine prompts for better results
* Contribute to team knowledge sharing on effective AI tool usage patterns

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business, or related field
* Hands on experience with Anthropic Claude
* Basic understanding of SDLC and software development methodologies
* Basic database concepts (SQL fundamentals, relational data)
* Strong analytical and communication skills
* Interest in growing into a full-stack engineering role
* Familiarity with React, .NET, Azure, GitHub, and CI/CD concepts
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) - habitual use in personal or professional projects preferred
* Foundational prompt engineering skills or strong willingness to develop them
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code rather than accepting it uncritically

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
The Android Bluetooth Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and optimizing Bluetooth connectivity solutions for Android-based platforms. The role requires strong expertise in Android application and framework development, Bluetooth Classic and BLE protocols, and hands-on experience with Bluetooth profile implementation and debugging. The engineer will work closely with platform, middleware, and application teams to ensure seamless communication between Android devices and external peripherals while delivering high-performance and reliable wireless connectivity solutions.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design, develop, and maintain Bluetooth communication features and frameworks for Android applications using Java and Kotlin.
* Develop, integrate, and optimize Bluetooth Classic and BLE profiles, including proprietary and standard implementations.
* Work with Android Bluetooth stack components (Fluoride/Gabeldorsche) and Android Framework layers (android, Bluetooth).
* Debug and resolve complex Bluetooth connectivity issues such as pairing failures, reconnection issues, throughput bottlenecks, latency concerns, and power consumption challenges.
* Analyze protocol-level communication using Bluetooth packet analysers and logs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including platform, middleware and hardware teams to deliver robust connectivity solutions.
* Support system integration, feature validation, and performance optimization activities.
* Review software designs, participate in code reviews, and ensure adherence to development best practices.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Android application or Android framework development.
* Strong programming skills in Java and Kotlin.
* Good understanding of Android architecture components, services, IPC mechanisms, and background processing.
* Experience with Android Bluetooth SDK and Bluetooth framework development.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Strong knowledge of Bluetooth Core Specifications, including Bluetooth Classic and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
* Experience working with Android Bluetooth Stack (Fluoride/Gabeldorsche).
* Familiarity with Bluetooth HCI logs, ADB, and protocol analysis tools.
* Exposure to embedded systems, wireless communication protocols, and connectivity solutions.

**Things To Know**

* This role is based at HARMAN International (India) Private Limited, Salarpuria Sattva Knowledge Court (SSKC), Bangalore.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands.
